claims.label: PROVED_AT_STATED_SCOPE
claims.statement: For the explicit odd edit family on g(x,y)=(-1)^(x dot y), the upper-cap averaging amplification is bounded below by L_r asymptotic to (13/16)^ceil(r/3)*(5/4)^(r-ceil(r/3)), and therefore diverges exponentially.

claims.label: REFUTED
claims.statement: There exists an absolute C such that the coherent scalar charge of every sparse odd bent-core surgery is at most C p sum_T e_T^2.
claims.falsifier: The explicit family has m*2^(-k/2)->0 but scalar/(p sum e_T^2)->infinity.
claims.scope: Only the absolute selector/L2 payment is refuted; data-coordinate and terminal-packet payments remain open.

claims.label: REFUTED
claims.statement: There exists an absolute C such that J=U(F)-(1-p)U(g)-pU(h)<=C I_ctl for every sparse odd bent-core point surgery with a fresh selector.
claims.falsifier: For p=1/2, the explicit family's cap-amplified scalar grows exponentially relative to I_ctl while the difference packet can subtract only O(r) I_ctl, so J/I_ctl->infinity.
claims.scope: This is not an FEI counterexample because physical data-core influence is deliberately excluded from the payment.
